stemMd: Which policy best fits the designers’ final view?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Permit several bench layouts while preserving designated clear routes

options.label: B
options.textMd: Prohibit waiting in the entrance hall

options.label: C
options.textMd: Permit furniture to block exits whenever users wish

options.label: D
options.textMd: Treat all departures from the initial layout as misuse

options.label: E
options.textMd: Fix every bench permanently in the first proposed position

explanationMd: The final view combines meaningful choices with operational constraints. Multiple layouts support user adaptation, while clear routes preserve movement and exit access. This captures the relationship described in the conclusion.

distractorRationale.e: That removes the adaptation the designers came to value.
distractorRationale.c: That contradicts the explicit safety constraint.
distractorRationale.b: Waiting was the newly recognized need.
